data.description:
#San Francisco eBike Rentals

# Duration 

2Hours , 4Hours, All Day

#About

Explore San Francisco's famous Golden Gate Park, with tons of sights and landmarks along with its beautiful bike paths - or see both the Park and the Golden Gate Bridge on one amazing, mostly flat 9-mile electric bike ride!
 
Unlimited Biking will arm you with all you need for your adventure - a helmet, a map, a bike bag/basket, and a bike lock, all free of charge – you just supply the need to explore! These pedal assist bikes will do a majority of the work for you so you can see more, with less work!

Visit all of the highlights of the park including Stow Lake Boathouse, Academy of the Sciences, de Young Museum, Conservatory of Flowers, Botanical Garden, Rose Garden, Dutch Windmill and more!

Golden Gate Park has a paved trail of around 4-miles from one end of the park to the other! After your ride, you can return back to our shop, or head towards the Golden Gate Bridge. Bikes can be returned at any of our locations.
**Operation Days**

April 1st - October 31st: Store Hours: 9am to 7pm
November 1st - March 31st: Store Hours: 9am to 5pm

**Tips**
Dress appropriately for the weather and bring your camera!
data.cancellation_notes:
**Bike Rental Cancellation Policy**

Please notify us at sales@unlimitedbiking.com at least 24 hours in advance if you cannot make your rental.  

For any cancellations within 24 hours of the rental, we can provide a full credit in the amount you have paid that will never expire!

Please note: If you reschedule your booking for a later date, we must receive your cancellation request 24 hours before your original travel date. If you reschedule for an earlier date, the 24 hour cancellation window applies to your new travel date.
data.booking_notes:
Please bring along a valid identification and credit card with you, as these will be needed for security upon check-in for your rentals. 

Address: 1792 Haight Street San Francisco, CA 94109

Please be aware of our **Store Hours**, as bikes must be returned by closing time:

November 1st - March 14th: 9AM - 5PM
March 15th  - October 31st: 9AM - 7PM

If you are planning to take the e-bike on the ferry, use the blue & gold ferry as they allow e-bikes on their fleet. 

For any questions, please feel free to reach our team at 415-854-2222. We'll see you soon!



**Know Before You Go:**

- Riders must be at least 13 years of age to ride an electric bike. We are unable to attach children's attachments to ebikes.
- Any riders under 18 years of age must have an adult present to check in and sign the waiver form in behalf of them. We require a valid identity card upon check in.
- For all our riders' safety, we are not able to accommodate any riders who are 300 pounds and over as this exceeds the weight limit the manufacturer has advised for the bike's build. We apologize for the inconvenience, but we do prioritize your safety during the ride. 

If anything from the list above concerns you or any members of your party, please feel free to reach out to our team by responding to this email. We will get back to you as soon as we can!
